subject: Quick thought on Kris Gethin Gyms Raipur and a quick preview
body: Hi team, I’ve been following Kris Gethin Gyms in Raipur and love how you connect local fitness seekers with vetted training facilities and transparent membership options. While browsing your current site, I noticed a couple of missed opportunities, specifically the lack of a quick interactive booking element and sparse direct contact options for users wanting to sign up on mobile. Because I enjoy working with fitness brands, I put together a clean, bento-grid style prototype for your Raipur location that features a streamlined search filter bar and prominent action buttons. Feel free to check out the live preview here: https://nayom-biz-0x3a28dd8243604649-0x4fd7c0c276461cb-drrgpno66.vercel.app. If you'd like to use this design or have me tweak anything, I'd be happy to send over the project files or chat for 5 minutes. No worries at all if you're happy with your current setup!
key_improvements: Added interactive search and filter bar for local gym discovery
Integrated prominent direct action buttons for mobile bookings
